# Figure — Objective Internality: the Six Paired Product Disclosures

**Asset:** [objective-internality-paired-disclosures.svg](./objective-internality-paired-disclosures.svg)

## Proposition

The return prepares six paired disclosures of Objective Internality. Each product is the subject of its **whole** MEF lens pair, not one subposition within a lens: Central through L0 Quaternal × L5′ Divine Logos; Actuation through L1 Causal × L4′ Scientific; AIKit through L2 Logical × L3′ Chronological; Software Factory through L3 Processual × L2′ Alchemical-Elemental; Workcell through L4 Phenomenological × L1′ Phenomenal; Quaternal Logic through L5 Para Vāk × L0′ Archetypal-Numerical. The figure makes the whole-pair rule inspectable against the per-product lens assignments as declared in the product records themselves.

## Transformations (construction method)

Hand-authored SVG. One row per product; the row's left box carries the unprimed lens, the right box the conjugate lens, and the centre card the product identity, its declared gloss and its movement number. Connector arrows run lens → product from both sides, rendering "the product is the subject of the whole pair". The whole layout sits inside a frame labelled S, the parent field. No subpositions are drawn inside any lens: the figure deliberately renders no lens internals, because the declared rule is that the product is not distributed among the pair's subpositions.

## Invariant

The declared pairing has the arithmetic property that the two lens indices of each pair sum to five. In display form:

$$n + (5-n) = 5 \quad \text{for each product pair } L_n \times L_{5-n}{}'$$

This is a **checksum derived by this record**, not a canonical derivation: the pairs themselves are declared data; the sum is the figure's stated invariant, usable to detect a mis-pairing in any re-render. A re-render must preserve: (a) the six declared pairs exactly as named in the product frontmatter; (b) one product card per pair, never a product placed inside a lens; (c) S rendered as the enclosing parent field, never as a seventh row.

## Proof boundary and omissions

- The figure renders declared assignments; it does not derive the MEF lens system. The lenses' own internal structure (sub-lenses, contents) stays in its owning records — including L5 Para Vāk's six contents and L0′ Archetypal-Numerical's six, declared in the central plan's S5 treatment, which the figure does not restate.
- Rail positions encode no ontological ranking; the vertical order is only the pairing convenience L0…L5 / L5′…L0′.
- The seven S records' developed bodies (commissions, primitive matrices, argument relations) belong to the product records and are not drawn.
- The M36 preparation movement is named in the anchored records but not drawn.
- The lens names outside the six pairs, the twelve sub-lens internals, and any claim about what a lens "means" are omitted: no gloss is drawn that the declared data does not state.

## Status

**Argued.** The pairings are declared canonical data; the product bodies carry `refinement_status: T25 developed/reconstituted; T26 ratification pending`, and the figure inherits that standing — it is a reference rendering of the declared pairs, not an independent confirmation of them. The index-sum invariant is **Derived** as arithmetic over the declared pairs.

## Caption

Objective Internality discloses itself through six products, each the subject of its whole MEF pair: Central (L0 Quaternal × L5′ Divine Logos), Actuation (L1 Causal × L4′ Scientific), AIKit (L2 Logical × L3′ Chronological), Software Factory (L3 Processual × L2′ Alchemical-Elemental), Workcell (L4 Phenomenological × L1′ Phenomenal) and Quaternal Logic (L5 Para Vāk × L0′ Archetypal-Numerical); every pair's indices sum to five, S remains the parent field rather than a seventh product, and no product occupies a mere subposition of a lens. *Status: Argued (declared pairs; T26 ratification pending). Source of record: the S0–S5 records, the A/C primitive constitution, central plan §5.*
